## Hydra vulgaris AEP — Pair Features & Logistic Model


```{r}
#always load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(pROC)
library(ggeffects)
library(brms)
```

###Load from previous script and make sure dup_type still in enviornment
```{r}
gene_table <- readRDS("hydra_aep_gene_table.rds")
nrow(dup_pairs)
print(count(dup_pairs, dup_type))
```
### Seperate to work with each dup pair
```{r}
gene_feats <- gene_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_name,
    gene_length,
    dist_near_gene,
    local_gene_density,
    scaffold_chr_length,
    is_opsin
  )

gene_feats_dup1 <- gene_feats %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    dup1 = gene_name,
    gene_length_dup1 = gene_length,
    dist_near_gene_dup1 = dist_near_gene,
    local_gene_density_dup1 = local_gene_density,
    scaffold_chr_length_dup1 = scaffold_chr_length,
    is_opsin_dup1 = is_opsin
  )

gene_feats_dup2 <- gene_feats %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    dup2 = gene_name,
    gene_length_dup2 = gene_length,
    dist_near_gene_dup2 = dist_near_gene,
    local_gene_density_dup2 = local_gene_density,
    scaffold_chr_length_dup2 = scaffold_chr_length,
    is_opsin_dup2 = is_opsin
  )
```

###One table
```{r}
pair_features_full <- dup_pairs %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_feats_dup1, by = "dup1") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gene_feats_dup2, by = "dup2") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_gene_length    = (gene_length_dup1 + gene_length_dup2) / 2,
    mean_dist_to_gene   = (dist_near_gene_dup1 + dist_near_gene_dup2) / 2,
    mean_local_density  = (local_gene_density_dup1 + local_gene_density_dup2) / 2,
    scaffold_chr_length = scaffold_chr_length_dup1,
    either_opsin        = is_opsin_dup1 | is_opsin_dup2
  )
```

```{r}
 nrow(pair_features_full)
ncol(pair_features_full)
```

```{r}
sum(pair_features_full$either_opsin, na.rm = TRUE)
```
```{r}
write_tsv(pair_features_full, "pair_feature_table_AEP.tsv")
```

### Modelling time
```{r}
model_data <- pair_features_full %>%
  filter(dup_type %in% c("TD", "DD")) %>%
  mutate(y = as.integer(dup_type == "TD")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    y,
    mean_dist_to_gene,
    mean_local_density,
    mean_gene_length,
    scaffold_chr_length_dup1,
    either_opsin
  ) %>%
  drop_na()
```

```{r}
num_cols <- c("mean_dist_to_gene", "mean_local_density",
              "mean_gene_length",  "scaffold_chr_length_dup1")
model_data[num_cols] <- scale(model_data[num_cols])
```

```{r}
nrow(model_data)
sum(model_data$either_opsin)
```

```{r}
bayes_model <- brm(
  y ~ mean_dist_to_gene + mean_local_density + mean_gene_length +
    scaffold_chr_length_dup1 + either_opsin,
  data   = model_data,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),  # bernoulli = binary logistic
  prior  = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = b),           # all slope priors
    prior(normal(0, 10),  class = Intercept)    # intercept prior
  ),
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 2000,
  seed   = 42
)
```

```{r}
print(summary(bayes_model))
```
```{r}
saveRDS(bayes_model, "bayes_model.rds")
```

```{r}
posterior <- as_draws_matrix(bayes_model)
```

```{r}
opsin_col <- grep("b_either_opsin", colnames(posterior), value = TRUE)

if (length(opsin_col) == 0) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find either_opsin column in posterior draws.\n",
    "Available columns: ",
    paste(colnames(posterior), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

opsin_samples <- posterior[, opsin_col[1]]

```



### What you need for images
```{r}
saveRDS(model_data,         "model_data.rds")
saveRDS(pair_features_full, "pair_features_full.rds")
```


```{r}
DUP_COLORS <- c(TD = "#ff6b6b", PD = "#ffe66d",
                SD = "#c77dff", DD = "#4ecdc4")

```


```{r}
type_counts <- pair_features_full %>%
  count(dup_type) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)
print(type_counts)
```

```{r}
p_counts <- ggplot(type_counts,
                   aes(x = dup_type, y = n, fill = dup_type)) +
  geom_col(color = "#0d1117", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(n), "\n(", round(pct, 1), "%)")),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.2,
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DUP_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Duplicate Pair Counts by Type",
    subtitle = paste("AEP genome | n =",
                     comma(nrow(pair_features_full)), "pairs"),
    x = NULL, y = "Number of pairs",
    caption  = "doubletrouble standard scheme (Almeida-Silva & Van de Peer 2025)"
  )
p_counts
```


```{r}
ggsave("eda_type_counts.png", p_counts,
       width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 200)
```

```{r}
long_feats <- pair_features_full %>%
  dplyr::select(dup_type,
    `Gene length (bp)`           = mean_gene_length,
    `Distance to nearest gene`   = mean_dist_to_gene,
    `Local gene density (genes/Mb)` = mean_local_density,
    `Scaffold length (bp)`       = scaffold_chr_length_dup1
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-dup_type,
               names_to  = "feature",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

p_ridges <- ggplot(long_feats,
                   aes(x     = log1p(value),
                       y     = dup_type,
                       fill  = dup_type,
                       color = dup_type)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha           = 0.65,
                      scale           = 1.2,
                      quantile_lines  = TRUE,
                      quantiles       = 2,        # show median
                      rel_min_height  = 0.01) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = DUP_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = DUP_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title    = "Predictor Distributions by Duplication Type",
    subtitle = "log1p-transformed; vertical line = median per type",
    x = "log1p(value)", y = NULL
  )
ggsave("eda_feature_distributions1.png", p_ridges,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)

```


```{r}

p_opsin_comp <- pair_features_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(either_opsin)) %>%
  count(either_opsin, dup_type) %>%
  group_by(either_opsin) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    group_label = if_else(
      either_opsin,
      paste0("Opsin-involving pairs\n(n = ",
             sum(pair_features_full$either_opsin, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),
      paste0("Non-opsin pairs\n(n = ",
             sum(!pair_features_full$either_opsin, na.rm = TRUE), ")")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dup_type, y = pct, fill = dup_type)) +
  geom_col(color = "#0d1117", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~group_label) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = DUP_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Duplication Type Composition: Opsin vs Non-Opsin Pairs",
    subtitle = "Note the elevated TD proportion in opsin-involving pairs",
    x = NULL, y = "% of pairs"
  )
p_opsin_comp
```

```{r}
param_names <- c(
  "b_mean_dist_to_gene",
  "b_mean_local_density",
  "b_mean_gene_length",
  "b_scaffold_chr_length_dup1",
  "b_either_opsinTRUE"
)
param_labels <- c(
  "Distance to nearest gene",
  "Local gene density",
  "Gene length",
  "Scaffold size",
  "Either gene is opsin"
)

p_trace <- mcmc_trace(
  as_draws_array(bayes_model),
  pars = param_names,
  facet_args = list(
    labeller = labeller(
      parameter = setNames(param_labels, param_names)
    ),
    ncol = 1
  )
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#ffe66d", "#58a6ff")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "MCMC Traceplots",
    subtitle = paste("Healthy chains show random mixing",
                     "with no trends or divergences")
  )
p_trace
```
```{r}
ggsave("bayes_traceplotsRLP.png", p_trace,
       width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 200)
```

```{r}
posterior <- as_draws_matrix(bayes_model)

p_post <- mcmc_areas(
  posterior,
  pars    = param_names,
  prob    = 0.89,     # shaded region = 89% credible interval
  prob_outer = 0.95   # outer whiskers = 95% CI
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "#ffe66d", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = rev(param_labels)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Posterior Distributions",
    subtitle = "Shaded = 89% credible interval; dashed = zero effect"
  )
p_post
```
